generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can appear green while the persisted specification/evidence packet is reduced, tautological, or hand-authored outside the canonical certificate builder.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Summarize the source, cite only successful CI, and manually fill certificate fields that should be derived from exact artifacts and scope.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: EVIDENCE-CONTRACT-INTEGRITY-001: require complete source-bound obligations, divergent negative controls, canonical builder provenance and deterministic prepublication validation.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Build the evidence packet from canonical source bytes and canonical certificate tooling before any remote handoff publication.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Reject zero-obligation coverage, tautological controls, missing producer provenance, invalid scope digests, and remediation ledgers not bound to the source audit bytes.

transfer_cases.case: Remove one normative list item from a synthetic issue source; coverage validator must fail.
Omit derived producer provenance or alter the issue-local path set; certificate/preflight validation must fail.

skill_changes.change: Canonical source snapshot plus certificate builder are mandatory before handoff publication.
skill_changes.evidence: Installed delivery skill contains fail-closed source coverage and builder provenance rules.

skill_changes.change: Terminal validators rederive obligations and reject non-discriminating or incomplete evidence packets.
skill_changes.evidence: Installed validators were executed against the rebuilt packet and passed only after full-source closure.
